name: pack-and-go-gh
description: Pack & Go - GH: logistics and transportation platform (monorepo)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/config
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api
